title: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
summary: A London lawyer investigates the odd link between his friend, the respectable Dr Jekyll, and a violent, hidden man named Hyde. The truth is revealed through a series of documents.
readIf: you want a short, classic story about the two sides of a person, in fewer than two hundred pages.
skipIf: you have not read it and want it to be a surprise, because its twist is now famous.

pairings.reason: Another Victorian cautionary tale about science, ambition and a creation beyond control.
Another story of a respectable face covering a hidden, corrupt double life.
